greeting: Nesha Keep regards you without hurry. (Oracle of the Refusal Field)

nodes.npcText: Nesha speaks in present tense even about the past. She does not predict; she observes what has not yet decided to happen. She is not unkind but the kindness costs her something each time.
I am Nesha Keep, Oracle of the Refusal Field. present-tense, observational, uses second person rarely and with deliberate weight

playerOptions.text: Tell me more about the hub.

nodes.npcText: The Unburned Court holds. The Ring of Doors opens only for those the hub will still name. Violence ends at the moss.
